run_train_mvit_model: run the MVIT model training pipeline using a config YAML file and distributed shard arguments
run_test_mvit_model: run the MVIT model testing pipeline using a config YAML file and distributed shard arguments
run_mvit_main_entry: run the main entry point to launch training or testing based on config flags
parse_args_mvit_cli: parse command line arguments for shard ID, number of shards, init method, config file, and opts
load_config_mvit: load and initialize MVIT configuration from a YAML file and override with command line opts
